'''Elin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic War]]. She worked as a dancer in the [[Siltshift cantina]] in [[Mos Ila]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elin appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Tatooine.
